{{Quote|Is this the kind of thing that CSF might notice?''"<br />"''Were we to get a little out of hand, I imagine very senior officers in CSF might need to be reassured, but not by you.|[[Arligan Zey]] and [[Kal Skirata]] discuss anti-terror operations on Coruscant with clone commandos|<ref name="TripleZero" />}}
The '''Coruscant Security Force Senior Command''' or '''CSF Senior Command''' were the senior [[Officer/Legends|officers]] in charge of the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] during the waning days of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TripleZero" /> They were located at the [[Coruscant Security Force Headquarters|CSF Headquarters]] in [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="TripleZero" />

During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]],<ref name="TripleZero" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="Date22" /> Senior Command was hesitant about [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] [[Clone commando/Legends|commandos]] conducting anti-[[Terrorist/Legends|terror]] operations on Coruscant. However, the [[Mission to Coruscant (Clone Wars)|mission]] was a success and the CSF [[Anti-Terrorism Unit]] was given the majority of the credit for dismantling of the terrorist cells.<ref name="TripleZero" /> The Senior Command was replaced by the [[Sector Command (Coruscant Security Force)|Sector Command]] after the formation of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]<ref name="SWCN2">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> around [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]].<ref name="Date18" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Coruscant Security Force Senior Command appeared in ''[[Republic Commando: Triple Zero]]'', the second novel in the ''[[Republic Commando]]'' series. The novel was authored by [[Karen Traviss]] and published in [[2006]].<ref name="TripleZero" />
